book.name: SAN MARCOS
book.title: Marco Jesucristo ye quetire ojaꞌque niꞌi

content: Jesú cʉ̃ wẽrĩꞌcʉpʉ masãꞌque niꞌi
Sauru na soowʉari nʉmʉ yʉꞌrʉ́ca beꞌro María Magdalena, apego María Santiago paco, tojo nicã apego Salomé ʉꞌmʉtise duucãrã niwã. Te meꞌrã Jesure cʉ̃ upʉre piopeorã waꞌarã weecãrã nimiwã.
Mujĩpũ mʉjãtiri cura maꞌma semana sãjãnʉꞌcãrĩ nʉmʉ soorinʉmʉ nicã Jesure yaaꞌcaropʉ waꞌacãrã niwã.
Na topʉ waꞌarã, aꞌmerĩ sẽrĩtiñaꞌcãrã niwã: —¿Noa marĩrẽ tiga ʉ̃tãgãrẽ tuupãobosarosari? nicãrã niwã.
Topʉ ejarã, tiga ʉ̃tãgãjo ti tutire biꞌacaga aperopʉ cũñacã ĩꞌacãrã niwã.
Tojo weerã ti tutipʉ diacjʉ̃ sãjãa waꞌacãrã niwã. Topʉ diacjʉ̃ peꞌe niꞌcʉ̃ maꞌmʉ dujicã ĩꞌacãrã niwã. Cʉ̃ yoaro suꞌtiro butiro sãñacã ĩꞌarã, ʉpʉtʉ ʉcʉacãrã niwã.
Cʉ̃ narẽ nicʉ niwĩ: —Yʉꞌʉre uiticãꞌña. Mʉsã Jesú Nazarecjʉ̃rẽ na curusapʉ paabiꞌpe wẽjẽꞌcʉre aꞌmarã weeꞌe. Cʉ̃ masãtojami. Aꞌtore marĩmi. Cʉ̃rẽ na cũuꞌcarore ĩꞌarã aꞌtia.
Beꞌro cʉ̃ buꞌerãrẽ, tojo nicã Pedrore wererã waꞌaya. “Cʉ̃ mʉsã dʉporo Galileapʉ waꞌayugʉsami. Cʉ̃ mʉsãrẽ todʉporopʉ níꞌcaronojõta topʉ cʉ̃rẽ ĩꞌarãsaꞌa”, ni wererã waꞌaya, nicʉ niwĩ.
Cʉ̃ tojo nicã tʉꞌorã, numia Jesure yaaꞌcaropʉ níꞌcãrã ʉcʉa narãsãrãta, omawãꞌcã waꞌacãrã niwã. Ʉpʉtʉ ĩꞌa ʉcʉaꞌcãrã nitjĩarã, na ĩꞌaꞌquere, na tʉꞌoꞌquere ãpẽrãrẽ wereticãrã niwã.
Jesú María Magdalenarẽ bajuamʉꞌtãꞌque niꞌi
Jesú boꞌreacã soorinʉmʉ nicã wẽrĩꞌcʉpʉ masãcʉ niwĩ. Titare María Magdalenarẽ bajuamʉꞌtãcʉ niwĩ. Coreta todʉporopʉre Jesú siete wãtĩa cʉogore cõꞌawĩrõcʉ niwĩ.
Cʉ̃ core bajuáca beꞌro cʉ̃ meꞌrã sijaꞌcãrãrẽ, cʉ̃ wẽrĩꞌquere dʉjasewãꞌa utirãrẽ werego waꞌaco niwõ.
“Jesú catiami, yʉꞌʉ cʉ̃rẽ ĩꞌapʉ” nicã tʉꞌorã, ẽjõpeoticãrã niwã.
Jesú pʉarã cʉ̃ buꞌesere sirutuꞌcãrãrẽ bajuaꞌque niꞌi
Jesú María Magdalenarẽ bajuáca beꞌro ãpẽrã pʉarã cʉ̃rẽ ẽjõpeorãrẽ bajuacʉ niwĩ tja. Na cãpũpʉ sijarãrẽ cʉ̃ apĩ weronojõ bajugʉ bajuacʉ niwĩ.
Beꞌro cʉ̃rẽ ĩꞌamasĩca beꞌro ãpẽrã cʉ̃ buꞌerã níꞌcãrãrẽ wererã waꞌacãrã niwã. Na quẽꞌrãrẽ ẽjõpeoticãrã niwã.
Jesú cʉ̃ buꞌerãrẽ “Aꞌtiro weeya” nise niꞌi

María Magdalenarẽ, tojo nicã ãpẽrãrẽ bajuáca beꞌro Jesú cʉ̃ buꞌerã oncere bajuacʉ niwĩ. Na baꞌadujiri cura bajuacʉ niwĩ. Na “Cʉ̃ masãcʉ niami” nisere ẽjõpeoticãrã niwã. Na ẽjõpeotise buꞌiri narẽ tuꞌticʉ niwĩ.
Beꞌro aꞌtiro nicʉ niwĩ: —Nipeꞌtiropʉ nipeꞌtirãrẽ yʉꞌʉ masãrẽ yʉꞌrʉogʉti nisere quetiwererã waꞌaya.
Noꞌo yʉꞌʉre ẽjõpeo, wãmeyenoꞌgʉ̃ yʉꞌrʉonoꞌgʉ̃sami. Yʉꞌʉre ẽjõpeotigʉ pũrĩcã buꞌiri daꞌrenoꞌgʉ̃sami.
Ẽjõpeorã na ẽjõpeosere ĩꞌorã, aꞌtiro weemasĩrãsama. Yʉꞌʉ tutuaro meꞌrã wãtĩa masãrẽ sãjãaꞌcãrãrẽ cõꞌawĩrõmasĩrãsama. Apemasã ye, na ucũmasĩtiꞌquere ucũmasĩrãsama.
Na añarẽ ñeꞌecã, tojo nicã nímá sĩꞌrĩcã, ne mejẽcã waꞌasome. Dutitirãrẽ omocã ñapeocã, yʉꞌrʉrãsama, nicʉ niwĩ Jesú.
Jesú ʉꞌmʉsepʉ mʉjãabutiaꞌque niꞌi
Beꞌro marĩ wiogʉ Jesú cʉ̃ buꞌerãrẽ wéréca beꞌro Õꞌacʉ̃ ʉꞌmʉsepʉ cʉ̃rẽ miimʉjãa waꞌacʉ niwĩ. Topʉre cʉ̃ pacʉ tiropʉ diacjʉ̃ peꞌe ejanujãcʉ niwĩ.

Tojo waꞌáca beꞌro cʉ̃ buꞌerã nipeꞌtiropʉ cʉ̃ yʉꞌrʉose quetire weresterã waꞌacãrã niwã. Na werecã, Jesú cʉ̃ basuta narẽ weetamucʉ niwĩ. Na weresere diacjʉ̃ta niꞌi nígʉ̃, añuse na weeĩꞌomʉjãcã weecʉ niwĩ.
